description: This file implements functions related to the absl::Status class, including status code to string conversion, payload management, and error creation functions.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Represents the status of an operation, including error code, message, and payloads.

methods.name: StatusCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a StatusCode enum to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<(absl::ostream&, StatusCode)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a StatusCode to a stream.

methods.name: Status::GetPayload
methods.description: Retrieves a payload of a specific type from the status.

methods.name: Status::SetPayload
methods.description: Sets a payload of a specific type in the status.

methods.name: Status::ErasePayload
methods.description: Removes a payload of a specific type from the status.

methods.name: Status::ForEachPayload
methods.description: Iterates over all payloads in the status.

methods.name: Status::Status
methods.description: Constructs a Status object with a code and message.

methods.name: Status::code
methods.description: Returns the status code.

methods.name: Status::raw_code
methods.description: Returns the raw integer code.

methods.name: Status::PrepareToModify
methods.description: Prepares the status object for modification.

methods.name: Status::EqualsSlow
methods.description: Compares two statuses for equality.

methods.name: Status::ToStringSlow
methods.description: Converts the status to a string with detailed info.

methods.name: operator<<(absl::ostream&, const Status&)
methods.description: Outputs the status as a string to a stream.
